overview.goal: Recreate and modernize the Hatcher Supply website for a local, mobile-friendly web experience hosted on Railway.
overview.importantPreference: Contact information, contact form, and map should not appear on every page. The full contact experience should live on the Contact Us page only.

businessIdentity.name: Hatcher Supply
businessIdentity.tagline: Your One-Stop Shop for Farm, Lawn, Pet and Garden Needs
businessIdentity.positioning: Family-owned and operated local supply store serving farmers, homeowners, landscapers, pet owners, and gardeners in the Huntingtown and Calvert County area.

coreMessages.message: Family owned and operated for over 30 years.
Three-generation legacy with deep local community roots.
Wide range of farm, lawn, garden, feed, pet, bird seed, and home essentials.
Staff provides product knowledge and loads purchases into customer vehicles.
Bulk delivery is available for mulch, topsoil, and Leafgro by calling to schedule.

currentSiteIssues.issue: Contact information and contact form are repeated across many pages.
Navigation includes a typo: Bulk Pruducts should be Bulk Products.
Product content is split into several small pages that could be easier to scan if consolidated.
Some imagery appears to be screenshots or lower-polish assets that may feel dated.
The site should better prioritize mobile calls to action such as call, directions, and product browsing.

page.title: Home
page.purpose: Introduce Hatcher Supply quickly, establish local trust, and route visitors to products, phone, or directions.

section.name: Hero
section.content: Use the Hatcher Supply name as the first-viewport signal with a concise local positioning line such as "Farm, lawn, garden, pet, and feed supplies in Huntingtown, Maryland."

section.name: Trust Snapshot
section.content: Highlight family owned, serving the local community since 1992, and helpful in-store service.

section.name: Featured Product Categories
section.content: Show concise category cards for Bulk Products, Landscaping, Feed, Pet Supplies, Bird Seed, and Home Essentials.

section.name: Bulk Delivery Callout
section.content: Mention that delivery is available for mulch, topsoil, and Leafgro and encourage visitors to call to schedule.

section.name: Photo Preview
section.content: Include a small preview of store or product photos linking to the Photos page.

avoid.item: Do not place a full contact form on the Home page.
Do not embed a map on the Home page.

page.title: About Us
page.purpose: Tell the family-owned local story and explain why customers trust Hatcher Supply.

section.name: Mission
section.content: Present Hatcher Supply as a leading farm, lawn, and garden supplier in Huntingtown, Maryland.

section.name: Since 1992
section.content: Describe the company history, family ownership, and commitment to the local community.

section.name: Customer Service
section.content: Emphasize expert knowledge, helpful staff, and loading purchases into customer vehicles.

section.name: Local Community
section.content: Use warm copy and authentic photos to make the store feel approachable and rooted in Southern Maryland.

page.title: Products
page.purpose: Give customers a clear, scannable view of what Hatcher Supply carries without forcing them through many small pages.
page.recommendedApproach: Use one consolidated Products page with category sections and anchor links instead of separate product dropdown pages, unless the inventory expands significantly later.

items.item: Mulch: natural brown, dyed black, brown, and red
Pickup loading into truck beds or trailers
Delivery for mulch, topsoil, and Leafgro by scheduling
Grass seed, including Hatcher's Mix, Kentucky 31, contractor mix, and Vitality Tri-Fescue
Bagged stone, including river rock, pond stone, marble rock, mini marble chips, pea gravel, and autumn red stone
Fertilizer and lime in 50 pound bags
LeafGro and straw for gardens and new grass seed
Bagged mulch, including hardwood, cedar, pine, and cypress
Erosion control products, including Curlex, silt fence, Smart Fence, staples, posts, woven cloth, and non-woven filter cloth
Horse feed from brands such as Purina, Triple Crown, and Triumph
Supplements, salt licks, grooming supplies, and feeding supplies
Sawdust, pine shavings, and pelleted bedding
Special-order support when customers cannot find a specific item on the shelf
Small and large bags of bird seed
Suet sold individually or by the case

page.contentGuidance: Use "Call for availability" where inventory changes seasonally or by supplier. Keep descriptions practical and easy to skim.

page.title: Contact Us
page.purpose: Centralize all contact information, map, directions, social links, and customer inquiry form.

section.name: Contact Details
section.content: Include address, phone, email, social links, and business hours if available.

section.name: Map
section.content: Embed a Google Map for 140 Thanksgiving Lane, Huntingtown, Maryland 20639.

section.name: Delivery Note
section.content: Add a clear note that customers should call to schedule bulk product delivery.

page.title: Photos
page.purpose: Show real store, product, bulk material, feed, farm, and community imagery in a modern gallery.

recommendations.item: Use current photos where quality is strong.
Create new images where existing screenshots or low-resolution assets feel dated.
Add descriptive alt text for accessibility and local SEO.

designDirection.brandFeel: Modern local supply store: practical, trustworthy, warm, and rooted in the community.

visualStyle.item: Use authentic store and product photography as the primary visual layer.
Use warm neutral backgrounds, clean white content areas, deep green accents, muted barn red accents, and charcoal text.
Keep product category cards clean and utilitarian.
Avoid a glossy corporate look or generic stock-photo feel.

mobileExperience.item: Include easy Call and Directions actions, especially on mobile.
Keep product categories scannable and thumb-friendly.

footer.recommendation: Use a compact footer with the business name, quick links, copyright, and simple call or directions links. Do not repeat the full contact form or map.

hosting.deploymentModel: Connect a GitHub repository to Railway for automatic deploys.

recommendedStack.primaryRecommendation: Astro is the best fit if the site is mostly static marketing content because it will be fast, simple, and cost-effective.
recommendedStack.alternative: Next.js is a good option if the site will later need heavier dynamic behavior, a CMS, or more app-style features.

features.feature: Contact form endpoint or third-party form service
Google Map embed on Contact Us only

localKeywords.keyword: Southern Maryland lawn and garden supplies

structuredData.item: Service area including Huntingtown, Calvert County, and Southern Maryland

existingAssets.item: Reuse current site photos where resolution and quality are acceptable.
Replace screenshot-style images with cleaner product or store photography.

newAssets.item: Create or photograph updated hero image showing the storefront, product aisles, bulk yard, or local supply-store feel.
Create category images for bulk products, landscaping, feed, pet supplies, bird seed, and home essentials.
Create an Open Graph preview image for link sharing.

implementationSequence.step: Confirm final contact details, business hours, social links, and whether the current email should remain public.
Collect or generate final visual assets.
Create the Astro or Next.js project structure.
Build shared layout, navigation, footer, typography, color system, and responsive styles.
Implement Home, About Us, Products, Photos, and Contact Us pages.
Add contact form handling and Google Map embed on Contact Us only.
Add SEO metadata, local business schema, sitemap, and robots.txt.
Optimize images and verify mobile layouts.
Deploy to Railway and test production URLs, form submission, map, call links, and directions links.
